sections.heading: Parul University vs Sigma Institute of Engineering for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Parul University if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.25 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Vadodara.
Choose Sigma Institute of Engineering if you want an admission route through CAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Vadodara.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹1.25 lakh as a tuition figure for Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM at Parul University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Sigma Institute of Engineering that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Parul University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Sigma Institute of Engineering here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Parul University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.

Sigma Institute of Engineering is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Gujarat. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Parul University is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded MBA / PGDM offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Parul University or Sigma Institute of Engineering?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Parul University and Sigma Institute of Engineering differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of MBA / PGDM classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Parul University vs Sigma Institute of Engineering?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹1.25 lakh for Parul University on Post Graduate Diploma in Management - PGDM; we do not hold a quotable fee for Sigma Institute of Engineering on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Parul University and Sigma Institute of Engineering?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Parul University here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Parul University and Sigma Institute of Engineering accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Parul University, and CAT for Sigma Institute of Engineering. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Parul University and Sigma Institute of Engineering in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Vadodara, Gujarat. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
